title: National Green Tribunal
lead: Established under the ==NGT Act, 2010==. Recently in the news for directing the CPCB to frame ==pan-India silica mining guidelines==, strict action on the ==Ghazipur landfill==, and deaths in Assam despite the ban on ==rat-hole mining==.

items: ==Expeditious disposal== of environmental, forest and natural-resource cases
==Reducing judicial burden== on the higher courts
==Accessibility== — a less formal, less expensive forum for environmental justice
==Implementation of environmental laws== — pollution control, forest conservation, EIA

head: Case
Holding
rows: [[Betty C. Alvares v. State of Goa]]
==Non-citizens can file environmental cases== — environmental justice is universal.
Directed states to implement the ==Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016==; prohibited ==open burning of waste==.
[[Srinagar Bandh Aapda Sangharsh Samiti v. Alaknanda Hydro Power]]
Power companies liable using the ==‘No Fault Liability’== principle.
Applied ==‘Polluter Pays’== — compensation for marine pollution.
==Suspended environmental clearance== for a hydro project to protect endangered species.
Banned ==old diesel vehicles in Delhi==; cancelled Chhattisgarh coal-block clearances; restricted construction in eco-sensitive areas like the ==Sunderbans==.

items.title: Issues
bullets: ==Resource constraints== — chronic understaffing; benches below mandated strength
==Jurisdictional limitations== — excludes the ==Wildlife Protection Act and Forest Rights Act==
==Lack of judicial oversight== — delegation to expert committees can bypass hearings, violating natural justice
==Credibility and transparency== — reliance on self-assessment reports; perceived bias against development
==Overreach allegations== — suo motu powers exceeding the statutory mandate

items.title: Solutions
bullets: ==Increased funding and resources== — full staffing of all benches
==Expanded jurisdiction== to include all relevant environmental laws
==Improved enforcement mechanisms== for compliance with orders
==Judicial oversight and natural justice== — all parties heard; no undue delegation
==Technology integration== for case management and hearings

blocks.text: The National Green Tribunal was born to be a green guardian, not a powerless observer. Unless its orders are enforced and its autonomy protected, environmental justice in India will remain more promise than practice.
